name: setup-guard-mcp
description: Version-Aware Setup, Dependency Compatibility & Migration MCP Server for the JS/TS Ecosystem.
long_description: Your agent reads the wrong docs. setup-guard makes it read the right version. Analyzes your project's actual Node.js runtime, package manager (npm/pnpm/yarn/bun), lockfile versions, and configuration files to supply deterministic compatibility checks and tag-pinned migration facts.

tools.name: detect_project_environment
tools.description: Detects Node.js runtime, package manager (npm/pnpm/yarn/bun), locked dependency versions, and config paradigms (ESLint flat config, Tailwind v4 CSS-first, Next.js App/Pages router, tsconfig) from local project files without network calls.

project_path.description: Absolute path to the project or workspace package root directory containing package.json

tools.name: check_dependency_compatibility
tools.description: Verifies engines.node, peerDependencies cross-compatibility, and deprecation notices deterministically using npm registry abbreviated metadata.

dependencies.description: Map of production dependencies and their version or range (e.g. {"next": "15.0.3", "react": "18.2.0"})

devDependencies.description: Optional map of devDependencies and their version or range (e.g. {"eslint": "9.14.0", "typescript": "5.7.2"})

runtime_version.description: Target Node.js runtime version (e.g. "20.11.0"). If omitted, engines.node checks are reported as unverified.

tools.name: get_versioned_setup_guide
tools.description: Returns citation-backed installation commands (formatted for the project's package manager), initial configuration file examples, and obsolete patterns to avoid for a specific library version.

library.description: Target library name (supported: node, typescript, react, nextjs, vite, tailwindcss, eslint)

target_version.description: Target version to set up (e.g. "4.0.0", "15.0.3", "9.14.0"). Do NOT pass "latest" without checking project versions.

package_manager.description: Project package manager detected from detect_project_environment

framework_context.description: Optional host framework context (e.g. setting up tailwindcss v4 inside vite vs nextjs)

tools.name: get_upgrade_steps
tools.description: Retrieves step-by-step migration guides, breaking changes, and official codemod commands between two versions of a library (e.g. Tailwind v3 -> v4, ESLint v8 -> v9, Next.js v14 -> v15) with GitHub tag source URLs.

library.description: Target library name (supported: node, typescript, react, nextjs, vite, tailwindcss, eslint)

focus_area.description: Optional keyword or section filter (e.g. "flat config", "caching", "async request", "postcss")

package_manager.description: Optional package manager to format codemod and upgrade commands accurately

tools.name: search_versioned_docs
tools.description: Searches tag-pinned migration guides, release notes, and deprecation notices for a specific library version using SQLite FTS5 (BM25). Resolves version from project_path lockfile if version is omitted.

library.description: Target library name (supported: node, typescript, react, nextjs, vite, tailwindcss, eslint)

version.description: Target library version (e.g. "15.0.3", "4.0.0"). If omitted, project_path must be provided to resolve version from lockfile/package.json.

project_path.description: Optional path to the project root so the tool can resolve the installed version from lockfile/package.json when version is omitted.

query.description: Search query: config key, API symbol, error message, or migration topic

top_k.description: Maximum number of chunks to return (default: 5)
